authority: $string rounds before it serializes. jsonata.org says only that a value is "converted to a JSON string using the JSON.stringify function", but that sentence names the three-parameter form whose replacer runs before ECMAScript's exact-number step — two of the same list's four casting bullets (functions to "", infinity/NaN throwing) are unreachable without a replacer — and jsonata.org's own published outputs are rounded ($sqrt(2) documented as 1.414213562373, byte-exact toPrecision(13), against an exact 1.4142135623730951). The digit COUNT is not documented and 15 is a recorded deviation: docs/spec.md 4.2.6 and jsntrs-jnv, decided 2026-08-15. jsonata.org, $string: "If prettify is true, then \"prettified\" JSON is produced. i.e One line per field and lines will be indented based on the field depth." The indent WIDTH is not documented; two spaces is JSON.stringify's space argument as jsonata-js passes it.
